instruction: Fix the native Altium board `C:\Users\user\Desktop\broken_ddr4_xsignals.PcbDoc` and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\ddr4_xsignals_repaired.PcbDoc`. Restore the DDR4 xSignal class as `xSignals_U1_J8` with members `DDR4_SODIMM_RESET_CONN_PP6`, `DDR4_SODIMM_DQS1_P_PP6`, and `DDR4_SODIMM_DQ9_PP8`. Restore the matched-length rule as `MatchedLengths_DDR4_SODIMM_U1_J8`, enabled at priority 8 with `7.874mil` tolerance, `CHECKNETSINDIFFPAIR=FALSE`, `CHECKDIFFPAIRVSDIFFPAIR=TRUE`, `CHECKXSIGNALS=TRUE`, and `CHECKOTHERS=TRUE`. Preserve the `All xSignals` superclass. Remove the damaged J9 names and `9.999mil` tolerance. [Software] To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).
